text.en:
The Mainit National Agricultural High School in the Municipality of Mainit, Province of
Surigao del Norte, is converted into a college of agriculture and technology to be known as the Surigao del
Norte College of Agriculture and Technology.

The College shall primarily provide professional and advanced vocational instructions and
training in agriculture, fisheries, forestry, and industrial technologies. It shall also promote research, advanced
studies, and progressive leadership in its field of specialization.

The College shall maintain in addition to a secondary education program, undergraduate and
graduate courses in the fields of agriculture, fisheries, forestry, and industrial technologies. It shall also offer
short-term vocational and technological courses.

The College shall be headed by a college superintendent who shall be responsible for its
administration and supervision.

All personnel, assets, liabilities, records and appropriations of the Mainit National Agricultural
High School are transferred to/absorbed by the Surigao del Norte College of Agriculture and Technology.

The existing appropriations for the Mainit National Agricultural High School are hereby
transferred to the Surigao del Norte College of Agriculture and Technology, to be disbursed in accordance
with the provisions of this Act. Thereafter, the necessary amount required for the operation and maintenance
of the College shall be provided for in subsequent General Appropriations Acts, until which time the operation
of the institution as a college shall be deferred, provided that its new name shall take effect upon approval of

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 21, 1983
